name: panel
title: Panel
description: Region frame with header, body and footer cells; PanelGrid joins panels into one frame with shared keylines.
whenToUse: Use it to frame one region of a screen with a header, body and footer of actions. For a whole application frame use App shell; for a record beside a list use Inspector.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: A region: 3px frame, region cut. Header, body and footer are cells stacked on shared keylines. Standalone panels sit one gutter apart. Inside a PanelGrid they become cells of ONE frame.

props.name: layout
props.description: cell: a cell of a PanelGrid (or any frame); no own border or cut.

parts.name: PanelBody
parts.description: Padded content. Standalone controls (2px) live here, one gutter apart.

props.name: flush
props.description: No padding: for rows, lists or tables that bring their own keylines.

parts.name: PanelFooter
parts.description: A row of cells on the bottom keyline: use Button layout="cell" for actions, or text cells for status.

parts.name: PanelGrid
parts.description: Joins panels into one region frame: children are separated by 1px keylines that stay correct at any wrap (the frame's line shows through a 1px gap), so a dashboard reads as one instrument, not a pile of cards. Children should be <Panel layout="cell"> (or any element with a background).

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum cell width in px before the grid wraps.

parts.name: PanelHeader
parts.description: Title (+ optional code and actions). The first header of a cut frame reserves the cut's room.
